tweets.text:
Dear Citizens of South Carolina, vote this out of control U.S. Senator from office during your upcoming primary. You don’t need him and our country can no longer afford to have him speaking as though he is speaking for all of America. He is not.

He is also embarrassing our @POTUS who I’ll never understand why he endorses him? 

@LindseyGrahamSC interests are not American interests nor are they South Carolinians interests. They are to stroke his own ego. 

Vote Graham out!

Vote @MarkLynchSC in and  let’s get some fresh ideas and common sense from a business executive and patriot into the next U.S. Senate.
